title: Only Fools and Horses Charity Quiz on Friday 25 September
preheader: £3 cash entry, all donated to Macmillan. Teams of up to six, 7pm start. No online payment.

data.heading: He who dares, quizzes
body: Join The Anchor and the Stanwell Moor Community Wellbeing Garden for our Only Fools and Horses charity quiz. Every penny of your £3 entry fee goes to Macmillan Cancer Support.
Reserve online, pay on the night. Entry costs £3 per person, payable in cash when you arrive. No online payment is taken.

image.alt: Only Fools and Horses charity quiz artwork for The Anchor and Stanwell Moor Community Wellbeing Garden, in aid of Macmillan Cancer Support

rows.label: Donation
rows.value: All entry fees go to Macmillan; prizes are funded separately

data.heading: Lovely jubbly, four themed rounds
body: Expect classic quotes, familiar characters and Peckham adventures, plus an interactive middle game and spot prizes. First place wins a £25 bar voucher, valid on food or drink for one month; second-to-last wins a bottle of wine.
Dress-up is welcome. Come early for dinner, served from 4pm to 9pm, and settle in before the first question.
This is an independently organised fundraiser in aid of Macmillan Cancer Support, not organised by Macmillan. It is a themed fan quiz, not an official Only Fools and Horses event.

data.body: Get your team together for a Friday night of classic moments and a good cause.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked with us before, or because you said you would like to hear from us. That may have been a while ago now, and we are glad you are still with us.
